items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1973-08-06
items.q: I brought Jimmy. He left here with me. And, that was the first time they had ever seen a string bass in a band.

ctx.x: What about, we were talking about the string bass, too. You say you had the string bass in Texas. Did they have many string bass players?

Mine was, well, you had this fella that was originally from Louisiana. They called him Manoon. I was living in Houston outside, but he wasn't playing too much. But, I brought Jimmy. He left here with me. And, that was the first time they had ever seen a string bass in a band. It was a novelty to them.
They were looking used to tubas out there.
